headline: Rudaw tallies ~1,000 drone/missile attacks on the Kurdistan Region since Feb 28
dek: Komala says its base in the Alana valley of Balisan, about 90 km northeast of Erbil, was hit at around 08:45 local and took material damage but no casualties; a security source told Rudaw an airstrike also targeted a house in Tawella, Halabja province, shortly after 02:00 Wednesday, badly damaging…
sources: Komala statement via Rudaw; Rudaw security-source reporting; Reuters (core Nov 4 report, already recorded as 1900-03)
fault_line: Iranian retaliation vs local score-settling: are Kurdish-opposition strikes part of the US-Iran war, or a separate Iranian campaign against exiled groups?

sections.what_happened: Komala says its base in the Alana valley of Balisan, about 90 km northeast of Erbil, was hit at around 08:45 local and took material damage but no casualties; a security source told Rudaw an airstrike also targeted a house in Tawella, Halabja province, shortly after 02:00 Wednesday, badly damaging it, again with no casualties. Komala's relations head Ali Ranjbari accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of the attack — an allegation not independently established; Reuters' original report named no perpetrator. Rudaw reports the Kurdistan Region has faced nearly 1,000 drone and missile attacks since 28 February, and its reporting does not link Wednesday's attacks to the wider US-Iran confrontation.
sections.what_verified: Reuters core (two explosive-laden drones, Sulaymaniyah + east Erbil, security sources) already recorded as 1900-03. Rudaw (T3) adds the Komala base location/time and the Halabja house; Arab News/Arab News PK and AsiaOne carry the Reuters wire (same family, not additional corroboration). Komala is the claimant, not a corroborating family, and carries no declared tier.
sections.what_disputed: Perpetrator unconfirmed: Reuters names none; Komala's IRGC accusation is a party claim with no independent evidence retrieved. Location descriptions differ slightly (Reuters: Sulaymaniyah + east Erbil; Rudaw: Balisan NE of Erbil + Tawella, Halabja province) — consistent with two separate strikes, but not reconciled by any official source. No casualty figure beyond 'none' from Komala/Rudaw.
sections.why_matters: Detail update only — no new Short; the no-casualty confirmation and the ~1,000-attack tally strengthen the 'second front the war rarely names' line if a future Iraq item leads.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE TO 1900-03 (Rudaw + crisis.zone summary, Nov 4): Komala names its Balisan base, confirms no casualties; second strike badly damages a house in Halabja province; Komala accuses the IRGC; Rudaw tallies ~1,000 drone/missile attacks on the Kurdistan Region since Feb 28
